_comment: Fixed per-theater facts, keyed by the name DCS-gRPC's GetTheatre returns (docs/adr/0079). utcOffsetHours: local = Z + offset, standard time, no daylight saving — which is how DCS itself keeps time. Syria +3 is a squadron decision (docs/parallel/decisions.md H11). Every other value is [SOURCE-DEFINED]: DCS does not publish these, and they follow the community-maintained table in MOOSE's UTILS.GMTToLocalTimeDifference(). Verify one against the mission editor before trusting it for a theater we have not flown. One object per theater so later facts (magnetic variation, decisions.md H15) sit beside the offset. Read once at startup, never written by code; a copy in state/theaters.json overrides it theater by theater, field by field. A theater missing here runs on offset 0 and says so (source MISSION_NO_OFFSET).
